name: TheHive
label: TheHive 5 API v1 — alerts, cases, observables, tasks, query
description: TheHive 5 API v1. Docs: https://docs.strangebee.com/thehive/api-docs. create-alert requires type, source, sourceRef, title, description. create-case requires title, description. Search ops POST /api/v1/query with INPUT query. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer api_key. thehiveHost is the origin. Never log api_key or case bodies. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: create-alert | get-alert | search-alerts | update-alert | delete-alert | promote-alert | merge-alert | create-case | get-case | search-cases | update-case | delete-case | get-timeline | add-case-attachment | create-observable | get-observable | search-observables | update-observable | delete-observable | execute-analyzer | create-task | get-task | search-tasks | update-task | delete-task | create-log | get-log | create-comment | search-comments | execute-query | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: alertId
schema.description: Alert id.

schema.label: caseId
schema.description: Case id or name for case/task/comment/observable-in-case ops.

schema.label: observableId
schema.description: Observable id.

schema.label: taskId
schema.description: Task id.

schema.label: analyzerId
schema.description: execute-analyzer: Cortex analyzer id.

schema.label: artifactId
schema.description: execute-analyzer: observable/artifact id.

schema.label: cortexId
schema.description: execute-analyzer: Cortex instance id.

schema.label: attachment
schema.description: add-case-attachment: platform file ref-id. Official API is multipart; OfficialApiNode JSON-posts.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Comment/log/observable message. Required on create-comment and create-log. Also create-observable.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Request-body parameter `parameters` for operation: execute-analyzer.

schema.label: isExternal
schema.description: create-comment isExternal. true = visible to external users.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Alert type (1–32 chars). Required on create-alert. Example: SIEM.

schema.label: source
schema.description: Alert source (1–32 chars). Required on create-alert. Example: Splunk.

schema.label: sourceRef
schema.description: External reference (1–128 chars). Required on create-alert. Example: SIEM-2026-001.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Alert/case/task title. Required on create-alert, create-case, create-task. Also used on updates.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Markdown description. Required on create-alert and create-case. Also create-task / updates.

schema.label: severity
schema.description: 1=low 2=medium 3=high 4=critical. create/update alert and case. Default 2.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Event epoch milliseconds on create/update alert and case. Omit to use now.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: String tags on create/update alert, case, observable.

schema.label: tlp
schema.description: TLP 0–4 on create/update alert, case, observable. Default 2.

schema.label: pap
schema.description: PAP 0–3 on create/update alert, case, observable. Default 2.

schema.label: flag
schema.description: Flagged on create/update alert, case, task.

schema.label: customFields
schema.description: Official customFields object or array on create/update alert and case.

schema.label: assignee
schema.description: User login to assign on create/update alert, case, task.

schema.label: observables
schema.description: Optional observables on create-alert. Each: dataType, data, message.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Case/task status. create/update case (New|InProgress|Closed) and task (Waiting|InProgress|Completed|Cancel).

schema.label: template
schema.description: Case template name or id on create-case.

schema.label: dataType
schema.description: Observable dataType. Required on create-observable. ip | domain | url | mail | hash | filename | …

schema.label: data
schema.description: Observable value on create/update-observable. Example: 192.0.2.1. Not for file type.

schema.label: ioc
schema.description: Observable ioc flag on create/update-observable.

schema.label: sighted
schema.description: Observable sighted flag on create/update-observable.

schema.label: group
schema.description: Task group on create/update-task. Example: Identification.

schema.label: dueDate
schema.description: Task dueDate epoch milliseconds on create/update-task.

schema.label: mandatory
schema.description: Task mandatory on create/update-task.

schema.label: query
schema.description: TheHive Query DSL body for search-* / execute-query / get-log. Official POST /api/v1/query. Example: {"query":[{"_name":"listAlert"},{"_name":"page","from":0,"to":10}]}.

schema.label: startDate
schema.description: Task log startDate epoch ms on create-log.

schema.label: includeInTimeline
schema.description: create-log includeInTimeline.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb. Search/* and get-log POST /api/v1/query. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: TheHive host
configurationParameters.description: TheHive 5 host without scheme. Example: thehive.example.com:9000. OfficialApiNode URL-encodes path placeholders.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: TheHive API key. Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in logs.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Node-scoped API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node via full URL key (.../runtime/message-events/<apiKey>) or X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header (verified alongside the provider's secret header).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Secret
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header Authorization. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: Authorization).
